name: Web Research
description: Search the web widely enough to answer the question and keep every source attached to its claim.

permissionsRequired.reason: Search for sources that can answer the question.
Read a specific page that a search result named.
Open a page in the existing browser session when the fetched text is not enough.

validation.rule: Every factual claim cites a web_search or fetch_url result. No source, quotation, or date was invented.
